stemMd: A 10 m cable makes a 30-degree angle with level ground. How high is its upper endpoint above its lower endpoint?
explanationMd: Vertical rise is the opposite leg, $10\sin30^\circ=5$. The horizontal projection would use cosine instead.

distractorRationale.b: Divides by sine when the hypotenuse is already known.
distractorRationale.d: Treats the full cable as vertical.
